_comment: A ticket is in-progress but declares no files - only reachable if a human
hand-labelled it, since the dispatcher refuses to claim a ticket without a
file list. Disjointness is then unprovable, so the pass must fail CLOSED:
nothing is dispatched and the reason is reported. #41 would otherwise be
trivially ready, which is what makes the refusal meaningful.
